user.title: Connect to Jellyfin
user.description: Connect the read-only search catalog to a Jellyfin server. Create an API key in Jellyfin and enter the user ID whose accessible libraries should be indexed.

data_description.server_url: Complete local URL, including http:// or https:// and any port.
data_description.api_key: Stored in the Home Assistant config entry and never included in diagnostics or search responses.
